title: Getting Started with daggr
text: Drawing DAGs ggdiagram ggarrow powerful requires ~30 lines boilerplate (helper functions, arrowhead config, theme setup). daggr wraps can focus graph .

title: Getting Started with daggr
text: common cause Z creates spurious association X Y. Conditioning Z blocks backdoor path. Fork (Confounder)
code: Z <- dag_ellipse("Z") X <- dag_ellipse("X") |> place(from = Z, where = "below left", sep = 2.5) Y <- dag_ellipse("Y") |> place(from = Z, where = "below right", sep = 2.5)  ggdiagram(font_size = 14) +   Z + X + Y +   dag_connect(Z, X) +   dag_connect(Z, Y) +   theme_dag() +   ggplot2::labs(title = "Fork (Confounder)")

title: Getting Started with daggr
text: effect X Y transmitted entirely mediator M. Conditioning M blocks causal path. Pipe (Mediator)
code: X <- dag_ellipse("X") M <- dag_ellipse("M") |> place(from = X, where = "right", sep = 2.5) Y <- dag_ellipse("Y") |> place(from = M, where = "right", sep = 2.5)  ggdiagram(font_size = 14) +   X + M + Y +   dag_connect(X, M) +   dag_connect(M, Y) +   theme_dag() +   ggplot2::labs(title = "Pipe (Mediator)")

title: Getting Started with daggr
text: X Y independent causes C. Conditioning collider C opens spurious path X Y. Collider
code: X <- dag_ellipse("X") Y <- dag_ellipse("Y") |> place(from = X, where = "right", sep = 5) C <- dag_ellipse("C") |> place(from = X, where = "below right", sep = 2.5)  ggdiagram(font_size = 14) +   X + Y + C +   dag_connect(X, C) +   dag_connect(Y, C) +   theme_dag() +   ggplot2::labs(title = "Collider")

title: Getting Started with daggr
text: Z instrument: affects Y X. unmeasured confounder U biases naive X -> Y estimate, instrument identifies causal effect. Instrumental Variable
code: Z <- dag_ellipse("Z") X <- dag_ellipse("X") |> place(from = Z, where = "right", sep = 2.5) Y <- dag_ellipse("Y") |> place(from = X, where = "right", sep = 2.5) U <- dag_ellipse("U", fill = "#708090") |>   place(from = X, where = "above right", sep = 2.5)  ggdiagram(font_size = 14) +   Z + X + Y + U +   dag_connect(Z, X) +   dag_connect(X, Y) +   dag_connect(U, X) +   dag_connect(U, Y) +   theme_dag() +   ggplot2::labs(title = "Instrumental Variable")

title: Getting Started with daggr
text: Pearl’s canonical example. Unmeasured Genetics confounds Smoking Cancer, front-door path Tar allows identification. Front-Door Criterion
code: Genetics <- dag_ellipse("Genetics", fill = "#708090") Smoking  <- dag_ellipse("Smoking") |>   place(from = Genetics, where = "below left", sep = 2.5) Cancer   <- dag_ellipse("Cancer") |>   place(from = Genetics, where = "below right", sep = 2.5) Tar      <- dag_ellipse("Tar") |>   place(from = Smoking, where = "below right", sep = 2.5)  ggdiagram(font_size = 14) +   Genetics + Smoking + Cancer + Tar +   dag_connect(Genetics, Smoking) +   dag_connect(Genetics, Cancer) +   dag_connect(Smoking, Tar) +   dag_connect(Tar, Cancer) +   theme_dag() +   ggplot2::labs(title = "Front-Door Criterion")

title: Getting Started with daggr
text: Adjusting collider M increases bias. U1 U2 unmeasured, conditioning M opens spurious path X Y. M-Bias (Butterfly)
code: X  <- dag_ellipse("X") Y  <- dag_ellipse("Y")  |> place(from = X, where = "right", sep = 5) U1 <- dag_ellipse("U1", fill = "#708090") |>   place(from = X, where = "above right", sep = 2.5) U2 <- dag_ellipse("U2", fill = "#708090") |>   place(from = Y, where = "above left", sep = 2.5) M  <- dag_ellipse("M") |>   place(from = U1, where = "below right", sep = 2.5)  ggdiagram(font_size = 14) +   X + Y + U1 + U2 + M +   dag_connect(U1, X) +   dag_connect(U1, M) +   dag_connect(U2, M) +   dag_connect(U2, Y) +   dag_connect(X, Y) +   theme_dag() +   ggplot2::labs(title = "M-Bias (Butterfly)")

title: Getting Started with daggr
text: Gender affects Department choice Admission directly. marginal association reverses conditioning Department. Simpson’s Paradox
code: Gender     <- dag_ellipse("Gender") Department <- dag_ellipse("Department") |>   place(from = Gender, where = "right", sep = 2.5) Admission  <- dag_ellipse("Admission") |>   place(from = Department, where = "right", sep = 2.5)  ggdiagram(font_size = 14) +   Gender + Department + Admission +   dag_connect(Gender, Department) +   dag_connect(Department, Admission) +   dag_connect(Gender, Admission, arc_bend = 0.4) +   theme_dag() +   ggplot2::labs(title = "Simpson's Paradox")

title: Getting Started with daggr
text: Use annotate() label layers, linetype distinguish causal relationships observed associations. DGP vs Measurement
code: # DGP layer dgp_ideo  <- dag_ellipse("Idéologie") dgp_behav <- dag_ellipse("Comportement") |>   place(dgp_ideo, "right", sep = 4)  # Measurement layer meas_ideo  <- dag_ellipse("Idéologie") |>   place(dgp_ideo, "bottom", sep = 3) meas_behav <- dag_ellipse("Comportement") |>   place(meas_ideo, "right", sep = 4)  ggdiagram(font_size = 14) +   dgp_ideo + dgp_behav +   meas_ideo + meas_behav +   dag_connect(dgp_ideo, dgp_behav, linetype = "solid") +   dag_connect(meas_behav, meas_ideo, linetype = "dashed") +   ggplot2::annotate("text",     x = mean(c(dgp_ideo@center@x, dgp_behav@center@x)),     y = 3, label = "DGP", fontface = "bold", size = 6) +   ggplot2::annotate("text",     x = mean(c(meas_ideo@center@x, meas_behav@center@x)),     y = -3, label = "Measurement", fontface = "bold", size = 6) +   theme_dag()

title: Getting Started with daggr
text: Use dag_rectangle() observed/constructed variables different linetype values encode edge semantics (e.g., definitional links vs causal effects). Political Attitudes DAG

à la dernière

title: Getting Started with daggr
text: Change fill distinguish different types variables (e.g., treatment, outcome, unmeasured). Custom Node Colors
code: Treatment <- dag_ellipse("Treatment", fill = "#2E7D32") Outcome   <- dag_ellipse("Outcome", fill = "#C62828") |>   place(Treatment, "right", sep = 4) Confounder <- dag_ellipse("Confounder", fill = "#708090") |>   place(Treatment, "above right", sep = 2.5) Mediator   <- dag_ellipse("Mediator") |>   place(Treatment, "below right", sep = 2.5)  ggdiagram(font_size = 14) +   Treatment + Outcome + Confounder + Mediator +   dag_connect(Treatment, Outcome) +   dag_connect(Treatment, Mediator) +   dag_connect(Mediator, Outcome) +   dag_connect(Confounder, Treatment) +   dag_connect(Confounder, Outcome) +   theme_dag()

title: DAG Gallery
text: Two conceptual layers — data-generating process (causal truth) actually observe. Solid arrows causal; dashed arrows observed associations.
code: # DGP layer dgp_ideo  <- dag_ellipse("Idéologie") dgp_behav <- dag_ellipse("Comportement") |>   place(dgp_ideo, "right", sep = 4)  # Measurement layer meas_ideo  <- dag_ellipse("Idéologie") |>   place(dgp_ideo, "bottom", sep = 3) meas_behav <- dag_ellipse("Comportement") |>   place(meas_ideo, "right", sep = 4)  ggdiagram(font_size = 14) +   dgp_ideo + dgp_behav +   meas_ideo + meas_behav +   dag_connect(dgp_ideo, dgp_behav, linetype = "solid") +   dag_connect(meas_behav, meas_ideo, linetype = "dashed") +   dag_connect(dgp_ideo, meas_ideo, linetype = "dotted") +   dag_connect(dgp_behav, meas_behav, linetype = "dotted") +   ggplot2::annotate("text",     x = mean(c(dgp_ideo@center@x, dgp_behav@center@x)),     y = dgp_ideo@center@y + 2.5,     label = "DGP", fontface = "bold", size = 6) +   ggplot2::annotate("text",     x = mean(c(meas_ideo@center@x, meas_behav@center@x)),     y = meas_ideo@center@y - 2.5,     label = "Measurement", fontface = "bold", size = 6) +   theme_dag()

title: DAG Gallery
text: complex DAG mixing ellipses (latent variables) rectangles (constructed indicators), different linetypes encoding type relationship.
code:
A <- dag_ellipse("Intérêt politique") B <- dag_ellipse("Autoplacement
Gauche-Droite") |> place(A, "top left", sep = 3.5) C <- dag_ellipse("A voté
à la dernière
élection") |> place(A, "top right", sep = 3.5) D <- dag_rectangle("Extrémisme", fill = "darkred") |> place(B, "top", sep = 2.5) E <- dag_rectangle("Participation
électorale", fill = "darkred") |> place(C, "top", sep = 2.5) ggdiagram() + A + B + C + D + E + dag_connect(D, B, linetype = 4) + dag_connect(E, C, linetype = 4) + dag_connect(A, B) + dag_connect(A, C) + dag_connect(B, C) + dag_connect(D, E, linetype = 3) + theme_dag()

title: DAG Gallery
text: Conditioning post-treatment variable can induce selection bias. , S (selection sample) caused treatment outcome, creating collider structure.
code:
D <- dag_ellipse("Treatment", fill = "#2E7D32") Y <- dag_ellipse("Outcome", fill = "#C62828") |> place(D, "right", sep = 5) S <- dag_rectangle("Selection
into Sample", fill = "#708090") |> place(D, "below right", sep = 3) U <- dag_ellipse("U", fill = "#B0BEC5") |> place(D, "above right", sep = 2.5) ggdiagram(font_size = 14) + D + Y + S + U + dag_connect(D, Y) + dag_connect(D, S) + dag_connect(Y, S) + dag_connect(U, D) + dag_connect(U, Y) + theme_dag()

title: DAG Gallery
text: parallel trends assumption visualized. Group (treatment vs control) Time (pre vs post) jointly determine outcome. unobserved counterfactual happened treated group absent treatment.
code: Grp  <- dag_ellipse("Group") Time <- dag_ellipse("Time") |> place(Grp, "right", sep = 4) Tx   <- dag_rectangle("Treatment", fill = "#2E7D32") |>   place(Grp, "below right", sep = 3) Y    <- dag_ellipse("Outcome", fill = "#C62828") |>   place(Tx, "right", sep = 3) U    <- dag_ellipse("U", fill = "#B0BEC5") |>   place(Grp, "below left", sep = 2.5)  ggdiagram(font_size = 14) +   Grp + Time + Tx + Y + U +   dag_connect(Grp, Tx) +   dag_connect(Time, Tx) +   dag_connect(Tx, Y) +   dag_connect(Grp, Y, arc_bend = 0.3) +   dag_connect(Time, Y, arc_bend = -0.3) +   dag_connect(U, Grp) +   dag_connect(U, Y) +   theme_dag()

title: DAG Gallery
text: running variable determines treatment assignment via threshold. Potential confounders affect outcome manipulate running variable precisely cutoff.
code:
R <- dag_ellipse("Running
Variable") Tx <- dag_rectangle("Treatment", fill = "#2E7D32") |> place(R, "right", sep = 3.5) Y <- dag_ellipse("Outcome", fill = "#C62828") |> place(Tx, "right", sep = 3.5) X <- dag_ellipse("Covariates", fill = "#708090") |> place(R, "below", sep = 2.5) ggdiagram(font_size = 14) + R + Tx + Y + X + dag_connect(R, Tx) + dag_connect(Tx, Y) + dag_connect(R, Y, arc_bend = -0.3) + dag_connect(X, R) + dag_connect(X, Y) + theme_dag()

title: DAG Gallery
text: multi-step model media influence political behavior, direct mediated pathways.
code:
media <- dag_ellipse("Media
Exposure") framing <- dag_ellipse("Issue
Framing") |> place(media, "right", sep = 4) opinion <- dag_ellipse("Public
Opinion") |> place(framing, "right", sep = 4) turnout <- dag_ellipse("Voter
Turnout") |> place(opinion, "below", sep = 3) partisan <- dag_ellipse("Partisanship", fill = "#708090") |> place(media, "below", sep = 3) ses <- dag_rectangle("SES", fill = "#5D4037") |> place(partisan, "left", sep = 3) ggdiagram(font_size = 14) + media + framing + opinion + turnout + partisan + ses + dag_connect(media, framing) + dag_connect(framing, opinion) + dag_connect(opinion, turnout) + dag_connect(media, opinion, arc_bend = -0.3) + dag_connect(partisan, media) + dag_connect(partisan, opinion) + dag_connect(partisan, turnout) + dag_connect(ses, media) + dag_connect(ses, partisan) + dag_connect(ses, turnout) + theme_dag()

title: DAG Gallery
text: complete mediation analysis DAG treatment-induced exposure-induced confounders.
code: X <- dag_ellipse("Treatment", fill = "#2E7D32") M <- dag_ellipse("Mediator") |> place(X, "right", sep = 4) Y <- dag_ellipse("Outcome", fill = "#C62828") |> place(M, "right", sep = 4) C1 <- dag_ellipse("C1", fill = "#708090") |>   place(X, "above", sep = 2.5) C2 <- dag_ellipse("C2", fill = "#708090") |>   place(M, "above", sep = 2.5) U  <- dag_ellipse("U", fill = "#B0BEC5") |>   place(Y, "above", sep = 2.5)  ggdiagram(font_size = 14) +   X + M + Y + C1 + C2 + U +   dag_connect(X, M) +   dag_connect(M, Y) +   dag_connect(X, Y, arc_bend = 0.4) +   dag_connect(C1, X) +   dag_connect(C1, M, arc_bend = -0.2) +   dag_connect(C2, M) +   dag_connect(C2, Y) +   dag_connect(U, M, linetype = "dashed") +   dag_connect(U, Y, linetype = "dashed") +   theme_dag()

title: DAG Gallery
text: variables measured error, observed indicators (rectangles) noisy reflections true latent constructs (ellipses).
code: # Latent variables X_true <- dag_ellipse("True X") Y_true <- dag_ellipse("True Y") |> place(X_true, "right", sep = 5) U      <- dag_ellipse("U", fill = "#708090") |>   place(X_true, "above right", sep = 2.5)  # Observed indicators X_obs <- dag_rectangle("Observed X", fill = "#37474F") |>   place(X_true, "below", sep = 2.5) Y_obs <- dag_rectangle("Observed Y", fill = "#37474F") |>   place(Y_true, "below", sep = 2.5)  # Measurement errors e_x <- dag_ellipse("e", fill = "#B0BEC5", a = 0.8, b = 0.5) |>   place(X_obs, "left", sep = 2.5) e_y <- dag_ellipse("e", fill = "#B0BEC5", a = 0.8, b = 0.5) |>   place(Y_obs, "right", sep = 2.5)  ggdiagram(font_size = 14) +   X_true + Y_true + U + X_obs + Y_obs + e_x + e_y +   dag_connect(X_true, Y_true) +   dag_connect(U, X_true) +   dag_connect(U, Y_true) +   dag_connect(X_true, X_obs) +   dag_connect(Y_true, Y_obs) +   dag_connect(e_x, X_obs) +   dag_connect(e_y, Y_obs) +   theme_dag()

title: DAG Gallery
text: network spatial settings, one unit’s treatment can affect another unit’s outcome — violation SUTVA.
code: D_i <- dag_ellipse("Treatment i", fill = "#2E7D32") D_j <- dag_ellipse("Treatment j", fill = "#2E7D32") |>   place(D_i, "right", sep = 5) Y_i <- dag_ellipse("Outcome i", fill = "#C62828") |>   place(D_i, "below", sep = 3) Y_j <- dag_ellipse("Outcome j", fill = "#C62828") |>   place(D_j, "below", sep = 3)  ggdiagram(font_size = 14) +   D_i + D_j + Y_i + Y_j +   dag_connect(D_i, Y_i) +   dag_connect(D_j, Y_j) +   dag_connect(D_i, Y_j, linetype = "dashed") +   dag_connect(D_j, Y_i, linetype = "dashed") +   theme_dag() +   ggplot2::labs(title = "Interference / Spillover")
